connections.observation: At 336d Thrasymachus prohibits five benefit-terms as answers about τὸ δίκαιον; at 337b Socrates answers with an analogy about τὰ δώδεκα that pre-lists four prohibited factorizations (δὶς ἕξ, τρὶς τέτταρα, ἑξάκις δύο, τετράκις τρία). The two prohibition-lists stand as parallel enumerations of forbidden answers, and at 338c τὸ συμφέρον, the last item Thrasymachus forbade, returns as the head of his own definition τὸ τοῦ κρείττονος συμφέρον.

Thrasymachus' entry is figured as a beast (ὥσπερ θηρίον) springing to tear (διαρπασόμενος) at 336b, then placed as speech εἰς τὸ μέσον, then localized again at 337a in the σαρδάνιον laugh. The animal-image, the middle-placement, and the marked laugh cluster his bodily manner across the section's openings of his speech.

The counterfactual ἄφωνος ἂν γενέσθαι at 336d is tied to priority of seeing (εἰ μὴ πρότερος ἑωράκη); the paired προσβλέπων/προσέβλεψα αὐτὸν πρότερος enact the same priority-of-looking that the counterfactual specified as the condition of speech.

The teaching/learning cluster (μαθεῖν, διδάσκειν, μανθάνειν) is doubled by a payment configuration: Thrasymachus demands ἀπότεισον ἀργύριον (337d), Glaucon answers ἔστιν and πάντες εἰσοίσομεν, and Socrates later says he can only ἐπαινεῖν because χρήματα οὐκ ἔχω (338b). Learning-from-the-knower is set beside monetary repayment, with praise substituted for coin.

The dense ἀποκρίνομαι-forms cross with Thrasymachus' prediction that Socrates εἰρωνεύσοιο rather than ἀποκρινοῖο (337a) and with Thrasymachus' own trajectory from ἐπιθυμῶν εἰπεῖν through συνεχώρησεν to φημὶ … εἶναι τὸ δίκαιον (338c): the contested act of answering shifts from Socrates (accused of refusing) to Thrasymachus (who ends by answering).

φλυαρία/φλυαρῇς and ὑποκατακλίνω each recur across speaker: Thrasymachus first hurls φλυαρία at Socrates (336c) and later uses φλυαρῇς to bar answers (337b); ὑποκατακλινόμενοι is his accusation at 336c and returns in Socrates' mouth at 336e inside the gold-analogy. Both terms cross from accusation into reuse by the accused party.

new_signals.observation: πρότερος recurs twice within 336d, once in the counterfactual about seeing first and once in the narrated act of looking first.
